proof.text: The endings with a loser are checkmate (`rules.win`) and receiving three checks (`rules.check_limit`). Both need a royal piece to be attacked. White has no royal piece and can never get one (`rules.promotion` targets Q, R, B, N; no drops). So White is never in check, never checkmated, and never receives a check. Stalemate is a draw. So no position is a White loss. White is not claimed to win.
